questions.question: Correct or qualify the blanket 1970s dating of academy elections: the National Academy of Engineering gives 1985, https://www.nae.edu/File.aspx?id=7387&v=f78f09b0 . Approve separate election dates in both versions.

localizations.source: Correct or qualify the blanket 1970s dating of academy elections: the National Academy of Engineering gives 1985, https://www.nae.edu/File.aspx?id=7387&v=f78f09b0 . Approve separate election dates in both versions.
localizations.ru: Исправить или уточнить общее «в 1970-е годы» для избраний: National Academy of Engineering указывает 1985 год, а не 1970-е: https://www.nae.edu/File.aspx?id=7387&v=f78f09b0 . Предлагается разделить даты академий в обеих версиях.

questions.resolution: The academy dates now distinguish election to the National Academy of Sciences in 1971 from election to the National Academy of Engineering in 1985, following the NAE memorial: https://www.nae.edu/File.aspx?id=7387&v=f78f09b0

questions.question: Clarify the four-volume work: Notes lists volumes 1 (1997) and 2 (2003) with M. Thapa, confirmed by the publisher at https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/b97672 and https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/b97283 . Distinguish the publication plan from volumes actually issued.

localizations.source: Clarify the four-volume work: Notes lists volumes 1 (1997) and 2 (2003) with M. Thapa, confirmed by the publisher at https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/b97672 and https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/b97283 . Distinguish the publication plan from volumes actually issued.
localizations.ru: Уточнить четырёхтомный труд: в примечаниях указаны тома 1 (1997) и 2 (2003) с М. Тапой; издатель подтверждает эти тома: https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/b97672 и https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/b97283 . Различить план издания и реально вышедшие тома; не утверждать выпуск четырёх томов без подтверждения.

questions.resolution: The text now identifies the work as a planned multivolume project and names only the two published volumes confirmed by Springer: https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/b97672 and https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/b97283

questions.question: Verify the first von Neumann prize and SOL foundation dates: the source gives 1974 and 1973, while Stanford’s timeline gives 1975 and 1974, https://msande.stanford.edu/timeline-mses-history . Consult award and laboratory records before choosing dates.

localizations.source: Verify the first von Neumann prize and SOL foundation dates: the source gives 1974 and 1973, while Stanford’s timeline gives 1975 and 1974, https://msande.stanford.edu/timeline-mses-history . Consult award and laboratory records before choosing dates.
localizations.ru: Сверить дату и формулировку первой премии фон Неймана и дату основания SOL: исходник даёт 1974 и 1973, тогда как хронология Stanford указывает 1975 и 1974: https://msande.stanford.edu/timeline-mses-history . Уточнить по документам премии и лаборатории, не подменяя одну спорную дату другой автоматически.

questions.resolution: The dates now follow the official records: SOL was created in 1974 and Dantzig received the first John von Neumann Theory Prize in 1975. https://msande.stanford.edu/timeline-mses-history ; https://www.informs.org/Recognizing-Excellence/Award-Recipients/George-B.-Dantzig

questions.question: Correct the attribution of the term “linear programming”: Tjalling Koopmans proposed it during Dantzig’s 1948 RAND visit; Dantzig developed the general model and simplex method in 1947. Sources: https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Dantzig_George/ ; https://sites.oxy.edu/lengyel/M372/papers/SIAM%20Remembering%20George%20Dantzig.htm .

localizations.source: Correct the attribution of the term “linear programming”: Tjalling Koopmans proposed it during Dantzig’s 1948 RAND visit; Dantzig developed the general model and simplex method in 1947. Sources: https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Dantzig_George/ ; https://sites.oxy.edu/lengyel/M372/papers/SIAM%20Remembering%20George%20Dantzig.htm .
localizations.ru: Исправить атрибуцию термина «линейное программирование»: его предложил Тьяллинг Купманс во время визита Данцига в RAND в 1948 году; общая модель и симплекс-метод принадлежат Данцигу (1947). Источники: https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Dantzig_George/ ; https://sites.oxy.edu/lengyel/M372/papers/SIAM%20Remembering%20George%20Dantzig.htm .

questions.resolution: Both editions now credit Koopmans with the term (1948) and Dantzig with the general model and simplex method (1947).
